summary: Deprovision mesh nodes by appending node_state=deprovision to them in the installer inventory and running the installer, which also removes their config files and logs; the first [automationcontroller] host cannot be deprovisioned.
questions: How do I remove an execution node from automation mesh?
Can I deprovision the first controller node?

answer_card.title: Deprovision a mesh node
answer_card.answer_md:
Add `node_state=deprovision` to the host in the installer inventory and run the installer:
```ini
[execution_nodes]
110-addr.tatu.home ansible_host=192.168.111.110
108-addr.tatu.home ansible_host=192.168.111.108 node_state=deprovision
```
The first host in `[automationcontroller]` cannot be deprovisioned. Not supported on containerized installs (use `awx-manage`).
